transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Um, I guess I came in because I've been having this issue lately. 

Well, it's like... once I start eating alone at night, it feels like something else just takes over. I can't stop. Even while I'm sitting there actively telling myself to put the food away and just go to bed, I just keep going.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever do anything to try to compensate for the amount of food you consumed, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

Yeah, I do. Um... after I eat like that, I usually end up in the bathroom making myself throw up. It just feels like the only way to undo what I just did, you know? Like I have to get it out before the calories actually settle in.
